Historical planning documents, preserved verbatim with provenance notes. These are **inputs to decisions, not current guidance** — the [decision log](../decisions.qmd) records what was kept, changed, or rejected from them.

## December 2025 exploratory refactoring analysis

**Status: exploratory working documents, not a team-adopted plan.** These came out of individual AI-assisted working sessions on the (now stale) `refactor/extract-packages` branch of `jheem2`; the effort was never socialized with the team and its branch is being mined for parts, not merged ([D-002](../decisions.qmd)). They're preserved because the dependency analysis remains the best structural map of jheem2, and because the lessons of that attempt shaped the current program's sequencing. **Provenance caution:** the dates *inside* these documents say 2023–2024; the actual work was committed November–December 2025. Git history is authoritative.

| Document | What it is |
|----------|-----------|
| [Architecture Analysis](2025-12-architecture-analysis.md) | Dependency matrix, 11 circular-dependency cycles, proposed 5-package layered architecture, cycle-breaking patterns. The analysis remains the best structural map of jheem2; its packaging endgame is deferred per [D-003](../decisions.qmd). |
| [Refactoring Execution Plan](2025-12-refactoring-execution-plan.md) | The 3-phase execution plan actually followed. Note it inverted the analysis's own test-first ordering — the core lesson behind [D-001](../decisions.qmd). |
| [Refactor Status](2025-12-refactor-status.md) | Where the effort stopped: "Phase 1 Week 1 complete + validated," including the `validate.R` fingerprint baseline. |
| [Refactor Issues](2025-12-refactor-issues.md) | Bugs and tech debt discovered during extraction — several are *current `dev` bugs* (unregistered S3 methods, load-time top-level code) queued as free wins on the [roadmap](../roadmap.qmd). |

Related documents that remain in their home repos (linked, not moved): `jheem_analyses/CI_PIPELINE_PLAN.md`, `jheem_analyses/SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_PLAN.md`, `jheem-containers/docs/CONFIG-OWNERSHIP-AND-CONTRACTS.md`.
